notes.title: Chapter 4 is now available!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Twi6JC4B_64

Hello again players!

We've just released the fourth chapter (of five) of the game [b]"R&D Laboratory"[/b]: while you are trying to help your workmates to make a backup of the company's systems, you will branch off your path to end up exploring the different rooms of the laboratory. Your intellect and the new gadget "SilverGlove" will be your only allies to reach your objective.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/0bb29ccf523c9c7b7c8fe758c2fcbb1654893c75.png[/img]
Manage gravity at your will and charge the SilverBall throwing it against the different laboratory's panels and try not to draw your superior's attention. Your journey at SilverCup is not going unnoticed and in the next (and last) chapter "We are a family" you will discover which side you are on. [b] Will you change the system or, like everyone else, will you join it?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/02ea5b8c064b75a83f1952cae592b698a4af2967.png[/img]
The next update will be the last one of Lost and Found - What if I come and find it before [b]leaving early access in 2026 with the fifth and last chapter of the story mode[/b], completely finishing the development of the game and reaching the 1.0 version.

[list]
[*] Chapter 4 released
[*] Improved visualization system of the inventory items
[*] Gameplay improvements
[*] Bugfixes
[*] New achievements
[/list]

[i]Chapter 4 french translation coming soon.[/i]

notes.title: Happy holidays from Gadir Team!
notes.notes:
We wish you happy holidays!

We want to give you some piece of information about the development of the chapter 4 now that you are on holidays.

When we started [i]Lost and Found - What if I come and find it[/i] our small indie studio was just created and we were integrating some ideas to the game bit by bit, some of them were not even planned during brainstorming. Each chapter that is released, we try to improve ourselves and avoid doing "same thing".

We believe that Chapter 4 is a challenge for us to prove that we can [b]give the best[/b] in each part of the game, thats why we are going to need more time to finish the next chapter of the story mode.

As we usually do, you got some new screenshots of what you can expect from the next update and we are already designing the [b]chapter 5[/b] which will be the last one and we are focus on delivering the best one of the game.

We wish that we wait is not too long four you.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/2340c0160e1a92f68e9d952675ec3d021097de18.png[/img]
Hello again players!

We want to tell you that even we still don't have the Steam deck verified yet, the game runs perfectly on the small (big) machine.

We love Steam deck and we (the dev team) have two of them that we are using constantly to test the game on it, therefore we recommend you to use the default config, in case you need to restore it is:

[b]Resolution: 1280x800
Graphics quality: High
Postprocessing: enabled
Volumetric lighting: enabled
Volumetric shadows: disabled[/b]

With those settings we guarantee that you will have a smooth and nice experience with [b]60 fps[/b] in most of the scenes, if you have any questions please don't hesitate to write in the forums or in our social networks.

notes.title: Celebrating chapter 1&2 news with 30% off!!
notes.notes:
Hi again, players! We hope you are having a wonderful summer.

It's been more than enough time since the last news we gave you about the story mode of the game and we believe it's a good time to bring you up to date.

After our attendance to Femanca 2023 we received really valuable feedback from all of you which made us reconsider some parts of the design of the first and second chapters. We think these changes have been for the best, since they polish some of the mechanics, they introduce the playable parts better and we have added more content which wasn't originally planned to both chapters.

notes.title: News about the story mode and community feedback!
notes.notes:
It was about time we let you know about new updates for Lost&Found - What if I come and find it, so here we go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/6fabd37b65e7577a6b0f428b2b41c47aea1e16ec.jpg[/img]

The last few weeks have been pretty interesting, we have been working real hard during all these months in order to prepare a demo for the 1st chapter of the story mode and get it ready for Femanca 2023 (festival del manga de Cádiz).

During the festival dozens of people came try both story and arcade modes and the feedback was very positive. It's been a pleasure to attend all of you and to see that you've enjoyed the game as much as we've enjoyed watching you play!
In addition, we have been able to get a lot of new ideas and improvements we'd like to include in future patches.

Talking about patches, we have decided to launch chapter 1 + chapter 2 all together, as we believe one single chapter might not be enough content for the experience we would like to provide, so it will take a bit more for you to enjoy the first story mode update. But no worries — when that'll be done, you'll have plenty of narrative content you'll be able to enjoy, and we are sure you'll be satisfied!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/b91463846ea808f64825c68469c8ae46053ee07d.jpg[/img]

We are going to focus on polishing and finishing the first chapter development and we'll bring you more news about this soon.

Thank you for your support, you don't know how much it means to all of us!

notes.title: Arcade mode's finished! (patch v0.42)
notes.notes:
A little more than a year ago, we launched the Early Access for Lost and Found - What if I come and find it, and today we want to celebrate it with a patch which [b]includes everything we had planned when we desgined the arcade mode[/b]. We are still open to suggestions from the community to include to the arcade mode. We believe in the potential of this mode if the community wants such thing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/044fd3a85b593b7833e8eb7df9ff03b59c167f77.gif[/img]

We are proud of the current state of the arcade mode because it lays the foundations for the playable mechanics of the story mode. It's full of new features, detailed below:

[list]
[*] New pack, "Even more lost", with 12 new lost objects.
[*] Third helper: the cart, a tool which will allow you to carry several items at the same time. Be careful not to load it too much.
[*] Added new achievements.
[*] [i]In game[/i] user interface fully redesigned and improved.
[*] Added an accessibility option which allows to change the subtitles size.
[*] Redecorated break room.
[*] Enlarged hall plus hall of fame makeover.
[*] Mechanics improvements and bug fixing.
[/list]

We hope you like the new content, and we want to tell you that we have started with enthusiasm the development of the story mode. We will keep you updated about it via Twitter, Discord and Steam.

[b]In 2023[/b], we hope to bring you more news and the [b]first chapter of the story mode[/b].
Thank you so much for everything!

notes.title: Roadmap 2021-2022
notes.notes:
It was about time that we brought you up to date, players!

We wanted to make the most of the game being a few months old to recap where we come from, what we have nowadays and where we are going to (roadmap below for impatient readers). Since the game release in October, we have released four content updates (and a new one is coming), all of them with their own achievements, new items and upgrades. Some of them were a petition from the community, like the 'Ducky pack'. We appreciate from the bottom of our hearts that you guys throw yourselves into the game!

'Lost & Found - What if I come and find it' is constantly evolving, and that's why it offers now (and will offer in the future) a lot more than what was released in October 2021, when we released the game at a very reduced price. We did that to show our gratitude to all those who trusted us, Gadir Team, to develop the game and to encourage players to try the experience and to give their opinion about it, making them part of its development.

At the end of April 2022, we will increase the game price to adapt it to its content and balancing it to other Early Access games which are being developed and have an interesting projection. This will allow our team to consolidate our position as developers over the course of time and to be able to devote more resources to its development'.

Having said that, where is the game going? How much is left to develop? Well, next we show you a roadmap 2021-2022 with which we hope to clear up any doubts and which shows the game evolution. During 2022 we will release more content updates (items packs, helpers and some new mechanics) for the Arcade mode. During those months, we will be working on the story design, levels, script... and we will give you more details through sharing artworks and updates in the Steam library.

[url=https://i.postimg.cc/pdNTB0Vw/Roadmapv2.jpg][img]https://i.postimg.cc/pdNTB0Vw/Roadmapv2.jpg[/img][/url]
(Click on the image for better resolution)

The last update for the Arcade mode will take place at the end of 2022 (unless further changes are made, as long as the community shows a great interest in them), and we will gradually devote our efforts to develop a narrative story mode made up of chapters and with a deeper and more interesting experience, which we can't wait to develop with all the ideas we already have in mind.

Without further ado, we can't wait to keep updating the game, to see you enjoy it and that you let us know it through our social media. Here you have a couple of sketches from the story design of Lost and Found.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/4a70b41329aaeda12dc5fd7255f659b58c0d5d40.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160923/9b267ac93d645e20e8275704e45dabd1e57f6137.png[/img]

Thank you all for being there <3
